evals.name: patrol-reports-changes
evals.prompt: You are the CI watcher of this Wheelhouse. Patrol, and tell the desk what changed.
evals.evidence: cat "$EVAL_STUB_LOG"; echo; bd list --json | jq -c '(.data? // .)[] | {title, labels}'
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/patrol.sh, and reports each change it prints, one line each with a linked short id: [widget #12](https://github.com/example/widget/pull/12) merged by squash, [widget #13](https://github.com/example/widget/pull/13)'s CI turned red, and issue [widget #20](https://github.com/example/widget/issues/20) opened. Merges nothing, comments on nothing, and may file a bead for #13's red CI.
assertions: The stub log shows the patrol's gh reads (gh pr list, gh issue list), as run by scripts/patrol.sh
The reply reports widget #12 as merged, and says it was a squash merge
The reply reports that widget #13's CI turned red (failed)
The reply reports issue #20 as new
The reply names each pull request or issue by its short form as a Markdown link, not a bare #12 or a bare URL
The stub log has no gh pr merge, gh pr comment or gh run rerun

evals.name: patrol-nothing-changed
evals.prompt: You are the CI watcher of this Wheelhouse. Patrol.
evals.evidence: cat "$EVAL_STUB_LOG"; echo; bd list --json | jq -c '(.data? // .)[] | {title, labels}'
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/patrol.sh, which prints [], says nothing changed since the last patrol, files no bead and stops.
assertions: The stub log shows the patrol's gh reads, as run by scripts/patrol.sh
The reply says nothing changed since the last patrol
The evidence shows no bead was filed

evals.name: patrol-reap-on-signal
evals.prompt: You are the CI watcher of this Wheelhouse. The desk signals: the human says they merged widget #12. Reap.
evals.evidence: cat "$EVAL_STUB_LOG"; echo; bd list --json | jq -c '(.data? // .)[] | {title, labels}'
evals.expected_output: Treats the desk's signal as a reap: runs scripts/patrol.sh for the Wheelhouse's repository, and reports widget #12 as merged by squash, as bead then pull request for the dispatcher (naming the pull request it cannot match to a bead), plus the other changes as usual. Does not look at GitHub any other way, merges nothing and comments on nothing.
assertions: The stub log shows the patrol's gh reads, as run by scripts/patrol.sh, and no other gh use
The reply reports widget #12 as merged by squash, with its linked short id, as a merge for the dispatcher to close the bead for
The reply says which bead widget #12 closes, or that it could not match the pull request to a bead
The reply still reports widget #13's CI turned red and issue #20 as new
The stub log has no gh pr merge, gh pr comment or gh run rerun
